version: "3.8"

services:
  issuer_coord:
    container_name: issuer_coord
    build: ./ISSUER_COORD
    env_file:

    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    networks:
      - my_network
    depends_on:
      - mongo-backend

  mongo-backend:
    container_name: mongo-backend
    image: mongo:5.0
    networks:
      - my_network

  frontend:
    container_name: frontend
    build: ./
    environment:
      REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: "http://backend:3001"
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    networks:
      - my_network
    depends_on:
      - backend

networks:
  my_network:
    external: true
    name: my_network
seguridad-social-web/vault-init/init-vau:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e

echo "Esperando a que Vault esté disponible..."
sleep 8

echo "Vault está disponible, configurando..."

# Habilitar Transit
vault secrets enable transit
vault write -f transit/keys/my-key type=ed25519

# Habilitar approle
vault auth enable approle

# Crear la policy
cat > /tmp/transit-policy.hcl <<EOF
path "transit/*" {
  capabilities = ["create", "update", "read", "delete", "list"]
}
EOF

vault policy write transit-policy /tmp/transit-policy.hcl

# Crear el AppRole
vault write auth/approle/role/my-role \
  token_policies="transit-policy" \
  token_type="batch"

ROLE_ID=$(vault read -field=role_id auth/approle/role/my-role/role-id)

# Crear secret_id usando -f (force) y parsear su salida con jq
# Primero instalamos jq (si no lo tienes, agrégalo al Dockerfile)
SECRET_JSON=$(vault write -f auth/approle/role/my-role/secret-id -format=json)
SECRET_ID=$(echo "$SECRET_JSON" | jq -r '.data.secret_id')

# Asegúrate de que la carpeta /env existe en el host (en docker-compose se montará)
mkdir -p ../env
echo "ROLE_ID=$ROLE_ID" > ../env/vault_approle.env
echo "SECRET_ID=$SECRET_ID" >> ../env/vault_approle.env

echo "Configuración de Vault completada. Role_ID y Secret_ID guardados."

seguridad-social-web/vault-init/Dockerfi:
FROM ubuntu:latest

# Instalar bash, curl, wget, y gnupg (para gpg)
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y wget curl bash gnupg lsb-release jq && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Instalar Vault CLI
RUN curl -fsSL https://apt.releases.hashicorp.com/gpg | gpg --dearmor > hashicorp.gpg
RUN install -o root -g root -m 644 hashicorp.gpg /usr/share/keyrings/hashicorp-archive-keyring.gpg
RUN echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/hashicorp-archive-keyring.gpg] https://apt.releases.hashicorp.com $(lsb_release -cs) main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/hashicorp.list
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y vault && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /app

# Copia el script de inicialización
COPY init-vault.sh /app/init-vault.sh
RUN chmod +x /app/init-vault.sh

# Este contenedor se ejecutará una sola vez, para inicializar Vault.
CMD ["/bin/bash", "/app/init-vault.sh"]

version: "3.9"
services:
  vault:
    image: hashicorp/vault:latest
    container_name: dev-vault
    environment:
      VAULT_DEV_ROOT_TOKEN_ID: "myroot"
      VAULT_DEV_LISTEN_ADDRESS: "0.0.0.0:8200"
    cap_add:
      - IPC_LOCK
    ports:
      - "8200:8200"
    command: "vault server -dev -dev-root-token-id=myroot -dev-listen-address=0.0.0.0:8200"
    networks:
      - my_network

  vault-init:
    build: ../vault-init
    container_name: vault-init
    depends_on:
      - vault
    environment:
      VAULT_ADDR: "http://vault:8200"
      VAULT_TOKEN: "myroot"
    volumes:
      - ./env:/env
    networks:
      - my_network

networks:
  my_network:
    external: true
    name: my_network
